items.title: Simulation: every upgrade and vessel is reachable; the campaign completes (simulation-measured)
items.detail: 21 targets × 10 seeds × winch 1-3/3, all affordable and bought through Game.buyUpgrade/buyVessel; campaign: 221 sourcing actions (38 hauls) for all 19 upgrades + 3 vessels at winch 2/3

items.title: Simulation: upgrades measurably change play (sail speed, turning, range)
items.detail: sail speed by tier on the Skiff: stock 6.5 → Canvas Mainsail 9.1 → Cutter Rig 11.1 m/s (beam reach); 180° turn stock rudder 2.7s vs Ash-Wood Rudder 1.9s

items.title: Balance is measured: headless simulations of economy, fuel, storms and voyages on the real game systems
items.detail: tests/sim (npm run sim): salvage yield, hauls-to-afford for every upgrade, campaign, fuel range, storm damage, voyages, exploit checks

items.title: Simulation: pacing between purchases (difficulty spikes)
items.detail: commission Scrap Trimaran: 19 actions vs ≤7 before

items.title: Simulation: the Stormwall as the final barrier
items.detail: Driftholm → Meridian Spire under the real loop: Ironwake arrived in 12/12 runs, 21.0 s inside the wall on average, losing 6.6-29.7% hull (best fit to stock sail). The Trimaran was swamped trying in 3/3 runs.

items.title: Simulation: no economy exploits through crafting, fuel or repair
items.detail: craft Refine Fuel then sell: ok; craft Hull Patch Kit then sell: ok; craft Alloy Plate then sell: ok; craft Engine Parts then sell: ok; craft Stitch Sailcloth then sell: ok; craft Strip Wire then sell: ok; buy fuel at driftholm: ok; buy fuel at hollow: ok; buy fuel at helios: ok; repair 35 hull at a dock vs a patch kit: ok; salvage respawn: clock set forward a day mid-session: ok; salvage respawn: clock set back, then one respawn of real time: ok; salvage respawn: relaunch after the clock was set forward a day: ok

items.title: Playtest bot: time from casting off to the first upgrade (game time)
items.detail: first salvage beacon at game 32.83s, docked again at 59.53s, first upgrade at 61.57s (bot drives straight; humans will be slower)

findings.title: Difficulty/pacing spike: commission Scrap Trimaran
findings.detail: 19 sourcing actions for this step vs at most 7 for any earlier step (campaign, winch 2/3).

findings.title: No progression dead ends found
findings.detail: Every one of the 21 upgrades and vessels became affordable and was bought through the game in every seed at every winch skill (hits_1, hits_2, hits_3).

findings.title: Captain's Log in the campaign stops at g_raiders
findings.detail: Completed: g_salvage → g_engine → g_crew → g_trimaran → g_helios → g_meridian. The raider goal needs real-time combat, which the simulation does not play; nothing after it can complete here (purchases are not gated by goals).

findings.title: Stormwall crossing
findings.detail: Driftholm → Meridian Spire under the real loop: Ironwake arrived in 12/12 runs, 21.0 s inside the wall on average, losing 6.6-29.7% hull (best fit to stock sail). The Trimaran was swamped trying in 3/3 runs.

findings.title: Storm damage
findings.detail: A full storm (storm 1.0) costs the stock Skiff 57.6 hull/min (swamped from full in 1.0 min); the Trimaran 57.6 hull/min (1.7 min). Riveted Armour cuts it by 45.0%. Below storm 0.4 there is no damage.

findings.title: Crafting margins are small
findings.detail: Hull Patch Kit: +2g (20%); Alloy Plate: +2g (11%); Engine Parts: +3g (14%); Strip Wire: +1g (11%). Not worth farming.

findings.title: Sailing never needs tacking
findings.detail: Stock Skiff: 6.5 m/s on a beam reach, 5.8 downwind, 2.9 dead into the wind (45%). Every boat can sail straight upwind at under half speed; wind shapes speed, not routes.
